path_lines.why: WOVEN-CROSSING-PATH (2026-09-27). Arriving at Chemical Plant's west edge, the path MATTERS: path_b_floor_witness --connectors on woven d6ce40fb, mtz_to_cpz right, layer 0 stops at x 5367 (the plane-A back of a loop, donor x ~7303) and layer 1 runs on to 5513. Sonic 2's path there is A: this Obj03 ($22: right -> A, high priority; left -> A, low) spans donor y 1024..1279, the corridor's standing height (1050..1087), and no other path-setting Obj03 across that band lies between it and the crop edge (x 7040). Its copy is placed in the corridor so the player crosses the mouth on A whatever he left Metropolis on.

crossing_overrides.why: s2_woven_2d's overrides with the report's three blobs. SNAP palette and parallax: every connector is drawn on CRAM line 0 and hides the background, so the switch happens while only connector is on screen (crossing_witness on s2_ehz_cpz and s2_mtz_cpz). BLOBS: A {EHZ, HPZ, WFZ}, M {CPZ, MTZ}, O {OOZ} fit the 376-tile arena one group at a time; a seam inside a group only repaints (3 frames), a seam across pays the group's overwrite chunks. ZONE_SEPARATION = screen: Z1 counts the screen. CROSSING_MARGIN is NOT overridden: every connector is the bake's own Z2 length or longer, and Z2 enforces it (controller ruling 1).

manifest.name: THE WOVEN SONIC 2 MEGA-ACT (layout v2.1): Wing Fortress over Emerald Hill, Metropolis and Chemical Plant; Emerald Hill over Hidden Palace; Chemical Plant a pocket inside Metropolis; Oil Ocean under them
manifest.note: THE WHOLE WOVEN ACT, layout v2.1 of docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-woven.md, written by docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-woven/build_woven_act.py (every length and position below is DERIVED there; re-run it, never hand-edit this file). Eight clips of six zones and eleven connectors: Wing Fortress across the top; Emerald Hill (the start) over Hidden Palace; Metropolis west | Chemical Plant | Metropolis east in the middle row; Hidden Palace's east piece under Metropolis west; Oil Ocean under Chemical Plant and Metropolis east. EVERY NUMBER THAT MOVED FROM THE REPORT, AND WHY. (1) CONNECTOR LENGTHS are the bake's Z2 rule (controller ruling 1: the 3-frame wipe, so a same-blob seam is 320 up/down and 416 across, not the report's 288 / 384) with the blob sizes the bake counts: blob A {EHZ, HPZ, WFZ} is 302 tiles = 9,664 B = 6 chunks + 3 = 9 frames (the report said 369 tiles / 10 frames; WFZ's lowered BG is an 18-tile window of its sky, not 83), M {CPZ, MTZ} 314 tiles = 9 frames, O {OOZ} 117 tiles = 6 frames. Minimums: C1, C4 320; C2, C3, C10 512 (report 528); C5 608 (report 624); C6, C7 416 (report 384); C8, C9 464 (=); C11 560 (report 576). Used: C3 512, C5 608, C6 416, C7 416, C8 464, C9 464, C10 512, C11 560 (all at the minimum); C1 512, C2 832, C4 560 (longer, forced by the tunnel floors below). (2) THE ACT IS 4 SECTIONS TALL (5 x 4, 8,192 px), as the report, with a row of fill UNDER every zone: the generator sizes the grid so at least one collision block of the neutral fill lies below the lowest clip (FLOOR_BELOW), and the clips end at y 6,144, so y 6,144..8,191 is solid stone. HISTORY: the first build of this act (4 sections) was refused by effects_gen ('rectangles of the 10240x8192 act belong to no region'), because the shipped OJZ region document, assembled but unbound in a clip ROM, was held to the clip act's rectangle and padded only to its RIGHT; the act shipped 5 x 3 with Oil Ocean on its bottom edge until CLIP-ACT-TALLER-THAN-DOCUMENT (2026-09-27) held that document to the act it was authored for. The 304 px of ARTLESS rows trimmed to fit 3 sections STAY trimmed (MEASURED: no art and no collision in any of them; the C5 floor pair in item 4 was chosen against this geometry): Wing Fortress donor y 256..383 (the piece is y 384..1791), Chemical Plant donor y 0..127 (the piece is y 128..2047), Oil Ocean donor y 1840..1887 (the piece is y 0..1839). (3) C6/C7, METROPOLIS | CHEMICAL PLANT | METROPOLIS: s2_mtz_cpz's measured, flown rectangles (its note has the floor search): Metropolis split at donor x 1520 (both halves on the walkway at y 640), Chemical Plant from donor x 7040 (its middle track y 1088 flush at both edges), Metropolis 448 px below Chemical Plant's donor origin. So C2 = C3 + 448 - 128 = 832 (a longer cloud climb). (4) C5, EMERALD HILL -> METROPOLIS WEST: K6 accepts Emerald Hill's east edge (donor x 8703) at floors 576, 736, 960 and Metropolis's west edge (x 0) at 256, 384, 672 (MEASURED). Emerald Hill's height only trades C1 against C4 (every other clip is fixed by other seams, so C1 + C4 = 1,072 whatever the pair). The tunnel runs Emerald Hill 576 (its high ground on the east cliff) into Metropolis 256 (its upper path at the west edge). The first cut ran 960 into 672 (Metropolis's start floor): after the trims in (2) that put the WFZ -> EHZ crossing 16 px from the WFZ -> CPZ crossing, and the region plan REFUSED it (no legal cut between two crossings closer than REGION_MIN_SPAN, MEASURED); 576 / 256 puts both crossings on one line (y 1664). (5) HIDDEN PALACE'S EAST PIECE IS RECUT (a FINDING): v2.1's rows, donor y 1504..2047, are SOLID ROCK in the art (no transparent tile in x 7248..8351) and the rock chunks' interior collision grid (floors every 128 px inside the rock), so a player would walk inside the rock. The playable band there is the lake bridge (flush at y 1376 on the piece's east edge) under an air band (y 1280..1343 is air in every column). The east piece is now donor y 1296..1599: 80 px of air over the bridge, the bridge, and rock under it. It ends at donor x 8336 (controller ruling 3: before the W3 pit at 8352, which the route does not need; the edge column 8335 is flush at 1376). Its top, y 1296, is what puts C10 at exactly 512 under Metropolis west's bottom. (6) C11, HIDDEN PALACE EAST -> OIL OCEAN: the HPZ bridge 1376 into Oil Ocean's west edge (donor x 8192) at 576, the ground Oil Ocean's piece starts on (K6 accepts 576, 624, 880, 1312, 1408, 1728 there). That sets Hidden Palace 800 px above Oil Ocean's top (y 3504, report 3136), so C4 = 560. C11 at its minimum then sets the L's width: its donor window starts at x 3792 (report 4688): west piece donor x 3792..6351, east piece x 6352..8335. MEASURED: collision 250 of 255 (the report's scan put starts 2304..3840 at 259 for ITS east piece, the rock rows). (7) METROPOLIS EAST is trimmed to donor y 0..1599 (report 0..2047) so its bottom is Chemical Plant's and C8 and C9 are both the 464 minimum; Oil Ocean then sits at y 4304 and x 5104 (as the report), where its top span donor x 10752..11007 meets Metropolis east's open bottom at donor x 1536..1631 (C9's lane). With Metropolis east full height, C8 would be 912 and Hidden Palace and Oil Ocean 448 px lower (past 3 sections, which was the limit when this was chosen). (8) SHAFT LANES, each on a span where both mouths are open (K10, MEASURED) and the camera model reaches: C1 x 2048 w 256, C2 x 3968 w 192 (Metropolis's open roof, donor x 800..991), C3 x 6384 w 256 (Chemical Plant's row y 128 is open at donor x 8192..9215), C4 x 704 w 256 (Emerald Hill's bottom is open at donor x 6656..7151), C8 x 5616 w 256, C9 x 7712 w 96, C10 x 3200 w 256 (Metropolis's open bottom, donor x 32..287). C1, C2, C3 are cloud bands (look cloud, Emerald Hill art as the shaft tests use; the look is the owner's call), the rest rock. LEDGES (top-solid, pitch 64 px, under the 80-px jump bound) on C1, C2, C4, C9, C10; C3 and C8 are drops. NOTHING CLIMBS INTO C1 OR C2 FROM BELOW: Emerald Hill's and Metropolis's ground is more than a jump under their top edges, so going up into the sky needs a spring (S2CLIP-OBJECTS); falling out of Wing Fortress works. (9) MUSIC: Emerald Hill SONG_S2_EHZ, Chemical Plant SONG_S2_CPZ; Metropolis, Hidden Palace, Wing Fortress and Oil Ocean name none (Metropolis's converts but does not fit the sound bank, S2CLIP-MTZ-SONG-BANK; the other three are refused by the importer, the report's section A.8). (10) THE START is Emerald Hill's ground (the start's why). (11) NOT A RUN-THROUGH IN EVERY ZONE: without objects, Metropolis's west half is cut by its pit (s2_mtz_cpz) and Chemical Plant's pocket is not a through route (WOVEN-CPZ-POCKET-ROUTE); the route witness places the player before each connector. OIL OCEAN HAS A FILL ROW UNDER IT (item 2): the 374 of its columns that were declared an unbounded fall on the 5 x 3 act now land on the fill at y 6,144, so there is no unbounded fall and no unpainted_remainder (clip_reachability MEASURED 0). (12) BUDGETS (the real bake, MEASURED): 20 of 48 sections (5 x 4), collision 250 of 255, art 2,894 pool tiles in 49 pages (37.5 KB stored, soft 24 / hard 64), worst camera window 12 of 12 frames (673 windows at 12, 0 over), largest section local map 801 entries of 2,047 (the 5 x 3 bake's figure; the new row is fill only and the local maps' total, 11.9 KB, did not move), SCREEN 0 mixed / 0 wrong / 0 void over 419,120 reachable centres, every crossing slack >= 0. Every one of these but the section count and the reachable centres (413,688 on 5 x 3) is the 5 x 3 act's number: the fill row costs sections, not art, collision or pages. Hidden Palace's and Wing Fortress's backgrounds hold still past their plane windows (WINDOWED-BG-VERTICAL-CLAMP).

Emerald Hill is the start (the woven report's section B: 'must, the start'); Sonic 2's own EHZ start (donor x 96) is 6,000 px west of this clip, so the act chooses a point, as s2_mtz_cpz does.

Eight clips of six zones and eleven connectors: Wing Fortress across the top; Emerald Hill (the start) over Hidden Palace; Metropolis west | Chemical Plant | Metropolis east in the middle row; Hidden Palace's east piece under Metropolis west; Oil Ocean under Chemical Plant and Metropolis east. EVERY NUMBER THAT MOVED FROM THE REPORT, AND WHY. (1) CONNECTOR LENGTHS are the bake's Z2 rule (controller ruling 1: the 3-frame wipe, so a same-blob seam is 320 up/down and 416 across, not the report's 288 / 384) with the blob sizes the bake counts: blob A {EHZ, HPZ, WFZ} is 302 tiles = 9,664 B = 6 chunks + 3 = 9 frames (the report said 369 tiles / 10 frames; WFZ's lowered BG is an 18-tile window of its sky, not 83), M {CPZ, MTZ} 314 tiles = 9 frames, O {OOZ} 117 tiles = 6 frames. Minimums: C1, C4 320; C2, C3, C10 512 (report 528); C5 608 (report 624); C6, C7 416 (report 384); C8, C9 464 (=); C11 560 (report 576). Used: C3 512, C5 608, C6 416, C7 416, C8 464, C9 464, C10 512, C11 560 (all at the minimum); C1 512, C2 832, C4 560 (longer, forced by the tunnel floors below). (2) THE ACT IS 4 SECTIONS TALL (5 x 4, 8,192 px), as the report, with a row of fill UNDER every zone: the generator sizes the grid so at least one collision block of the neutral fill lies below the lowest clip (FLOOR_BELOW), and the clips end at y 6,144, so y 6,144..8,191 is solid stone. HISTORY: the first build of this act (4 sections) was refused by effects_gen ('rectangles of the 10240x8192 act belong to no region'), because the shipped OJZ region document, assembled but unbound in a clip ROM, was held to the clip act's rectangle and padded only to its RIGHT; the act shipped 5 x 3 with Oil Ocean on its bottom edge until CLIP-ACT-TALLER-THAN-DOCUMENT (2026-09-27) held that document to the act it was authored for. The 304 px of ARTLESS rows trimmed to fit 3 sections STAY trimmed (MEASURED: no art and no collision in any of them; the C5 floor pair in item 4 was chosen against this geometry): Wing Fortress donor y 256..383 (the piece is y 384..1791), Chemical Plant donor y 0..127 (the piece is y 128..2047), Oil Ocean donor y 1840..1887 (the piece is y 0..1839). (3) C6/C7, METROPOLIS | CHEMICAL PLANT | METROPOLIS: s2_mtz_cpz's measured, flown rectangles (its note has the floor search): Metropolis split at donor x 1520 (both halves on the walkway at y 640), Chemical Plant from donor x 7040 (its middle track y 1088 flush at both edges), Metropolis 448 px below Chemical Plant's donor origin. So C2 = C3 + 448 - 128 = 832 (a longer cloud climb). (4) C5, EMERALD HILL -> METROPOLIS WEST: K6 accepts Emerald Hill's east edge (donor x 8703) at floors 576, 736, 960 and Metropolis's west edge (x 0) at 256, 384, 672 (MEASURED). Emerald Hill's height only trades C1 against C4 (every other clip is fixed by other seams, so C1 + C4 = 1,072 whatever the pair). The tunnel runs Emerald Hill 576 (its high ground on the east cliff) into Metropolis 256 (its upper path at the west edge). The first cut ran 960 into 672 (Metropolis's start floor): after the trims in (2) that put the WFZ -> EHZ crossing 16 px from the WFZ -> CPZ crossing, and the region plan REFUSED it (no legal cut between two crossings closer than REGION_MIN_SPAN, MEASURED); 576 / 256 puts both crossings on one line (y 1664). (5) HIDDEN PALACE'S EAST PIECE IS RECUT (a FINDING): v2.1's rows, donor y 1504..2047, are SOLID ROCK in the art (no transparent tile in x 7248..8351) and the rock chunks' interior collision grid (floors every 128 px inside the rock), so a player would walk inside the rock. The playable band there is the lake bridge (flush at y 1376 on the piece's east edge) under an air band (y 1280..1343 is air in every column). The east piece is now donor y 1296..1599: 80 px of air over the bridge, the bridge, and rock under it. It ends at donor x 8336 (controller ruling 3: before the W3 pit at 8352, which the route does not need; the edge column 8335 is flush at 1376). Its top, y 1296, is what puts C10 at exactly 512 under Metropolis west's bottom. (6) C11, HIDDEN PALACE EAST -> OIL OCEAN: the HPZ bridge 1376 into Oil Ocean's west edge (donor x 8192) at 576, the ground Oil Ocean's piece starts on (K6 accepts 576, 624, 880, 1312, 1408, 1728 there). That sets Hidden Palace 800 px above Oil Ocean's top (y 3504, report 3136), so C4 = 560. C11 at its minimum then sets the L's width: its donor window starts at x 3792 (report 4688): west piece donor x 3792..6351, east piece x 6352..8335. MEASURED: collision 250 of 255 (the report's scan put starts 2304..3840 at 259 for ITS east piece, the rock rows). (7) METROPOLIS EAST is trimmed to donor y 0..1599 (report 0..2047) so its bottom is Chemical Plant's and C8 and C9 are both the 464 minimum; Oil Ocean then sits at y 4304 and x 5104 (as the report), where its top span donor x 10752..11007 meets Metropolis east's open bottom at donor x 1536..1631 (C9's lane). With Metropolis east full height, C8 would be 912 and Hidden Palace and Oil Ocean 448 px lower (past 3 sections, which was the limit when this was chosen). (8) SHAFT LANES, each on a span where both mouths are open (K10, MEASURED) and the camera model reaches: C1 x 2048 w 256, C2 x 3968 w 192 (Metropolis's open roof, donor x 800..991), C3 x 6384 w 256 (Chemical Plant's row y 128 is open at donor x 8192..9215), C4 x 704 w 256 (Emerald Hill's bottom is open at donor x 6656..7151), C8 x 5616 w 256, C9 x 7712 w 96, C10 x 3200 w 256 (Metropolis's open bottom, donor x 32..287). C1, C2, C3 are cloud bands (look cloud, Emerald Hill art as the shaft tests use; the look is the owner's call), the rest rock. LEDGES (top-solid, pitch 64 px, under the 80-px jump bound) on C1, C2, C4, C9, C10; C3 and C8 are drops. NOTHING CLIMBS INTO C1 OR C2 FROM BELOW: Emerald Hill's and Metropolis's ground is more than a jump under their top edges, so going up into the sky needs a spring (S2CLIP-OBJECTS); falling out of Wing Fortress works. (9) MUSIC: Emerald Hill SONG_S2_EHZ, Chemical Plant SONG_S2_CPZ; Metropolis, Hidden Palace, Wing Fortress and Oil Ocean name none (Metropolis's converts but does not fit the sound bank, S2CLIP-MTZ-SONG-BANK; the other three are refused by the importer, the report's section A.8). (10) THE START is Emerald Hill's ground (the start's why). (11) NOT A RUN-THROUGH IN EVERY ZONE: without objects, Metropolis's west half is cut by its pit (s2_mtz_cpz) and Chemical Plant's pocket is not a through route (WOVEN-CPZ-POCKET-ROUTE); the route witness places the player before each connector. OIL OCEAN HAS A FILL ROW UNDER IT (item 2): the 374 of its columns that were declared an unbounded fall on the 5 x 3 act now land on the fill at y 6,144, so there is no unbounded fall and no unpainted_remainder (clip_reachability MEASURED 0). (12) BUDGETS (the real bake, MEASURED): 20 of 48 sections (5 x 4), collision 250 of 255, art 2,894 pool tiles in 49 pages (37.5 KB stored, soft 24 / hard 64), worst camera window 12 of 12 frames (673 windows at 12, 0 over), largest section local map 801 entries of 2,047 (the 5 x 3 bake's figure; the new row is fill only and the local maps' total, 11.9 KB, did not move), SCREEN 0 mixed / 0 wrong / 0 void over 419,120 reachable centres, every crossing slack >= 0. Every one of these but the section count and the reachable centres (413,688 on 5 x 3) is the 5 x 3 act's number: the fill row costs sections, not art, collision or pages. Hidden Palace's and Wing Fortress's backgrounds hold still past their plane windows (WINDOWED-BG-VERTICAL-CLAMP).

start.why: ON EMERALD HILL'S GROUND, 320 px into its clip (donor EHZ x 6464), feet on its surface at donor y 432 (plane-A solid; the spawn is PLAYER_Y_RADIUS = 19 px above it; clip_rom_bake ground corroborates it on every bake). Emerald Hill is the start (the woven report's section B: 'must, the start'); Sonic 2's own EHZ start (donor x 96) is 6,000 px west of this clip, so the act chooses a point, as s2_mtz_cpz does.

path_lines.why: WOVEN-CROSSING-PATH (2026-09-27). Arriving at Chemical Plant's west edge, the path MATTERS: path_b_floor_witness --connectors on woven d6ce40fb, mtz_to_cpz right, layer 0 stops at x 5367 (the plane-A back of a loop, donor x ~7303) and layer 1 runs on to 5513. Sonic 2's path there is A: this Obj03 ($22: right -> A, high priority; left -> A, low) spans donor y 1024..1279, the corridor's standing height (1050..1087), and no other path-setting Obj03 across that band lies between it and the crop edge (x 7040). Its copy is placed in the corridor so the player crosses the mouth on A whatever he left Metropolis on.

crossing_overrides.why: s2_woven_2d's overrides with the report's three blobs. SNAP palette and parallax: every connector is drawn on CRAM line 0 and hides the background, so the switch happens while only connector is on screen (crossing_witness on s2_ehz_cpz and s2_mtz_cpz). BLOBS: A {EHZ, HPZ, WFZ}, M {CPZ, MTZ}, O {OOZ} fit the 376-tile arena one group at a time; a seam inside a group only repaints (3 frames), a seam across pays the group's overwrite chunks. ZONE_SEPARATION = screen: Z1 counts the screen. CROSSING_MARGIN is NOT overridden: every connector is the bake's own Z2 length or longer, and Z2 enforces it (controller ruling 1).

fill.why: Everything between the zones is neutral: solid stone on CRAM line 0 (the woven report's item 6), so no background shows between zones and no Sonic 2 pit falls out of the act.
